# DrawBoard

> A free, open-source, browser-based whiteboard for sketching diagrams, wireframes, and notes in a hand-drawn style — inspired by Excalidraw. It runs entirely client-side: there is no account, no login, and nothing to install. Drawings autosave to the visitor's own browser (IndexedDB), not to a server. The project is open source under the MIT License.

## Key facts

- **Price:** Free, with no paid tier.
- **Account required:** No — there is no login system at all.
- **Where it runs:** Entirely in the browser (client-side). No installation needed.
- **License:** MIT (permissive open source).
- **Self-hostable:** Yes — clone the GitHub repo and run `npm install && npm run dev`.
- **Data privacy:** Drawings are stored only in the user's own browser by default; nothing is uploaded to a server unless the user explicitly exports a file or opts into the optional real-time collaboration feature.

## How to use it

1. Open https://draw.designpav.in — no sign-up step.
2. Pick a tool from the top toolbar (selection, rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow, line, freehand draw, text, image, eraser, or frame) and draw on the canvas.
3. Style the selected element using the panel on the left (stroke color, fill, stroke width, sloppiness, edges, opacity, fonts).
4. Export the result as PNG, SVG, or a native JSON (.excalidraw-style) file via the menu, or copy it to the clipboard as an image.

## Features

- Drawing tools: selection, rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow (with 5 arrowhead styles per end), line, freehand draw, text, image insert, eraser, frame, hand/pan.
- Styling: stroke/background color, fill style (hachure/cross-hatch/solid), stroke width & style, sloppiness (hand-drawn roughness), sharp/round edges, opacity, font family/size/alignment.
- Selection tools: multi-select, resize, rotate, group/ungroup, lock, layering (bring to front/back), duplicate, undo/redo.
- A reusable shape library, importable/exportable as `.excalidrawlib` files.
- Export to PNG (with transparency option), SVG, or native JSON; import existing files; copy to clipboard as an image.
- Infinite pan/zoom canvas, optional grid, dark/light theme, custom canvas background color.
- Autosave to the browser's local storage — no save button needed.
- Installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline support.
- Optional real-time multi-user collaboration (not enabled on the public draw.designpav.in deployment; available when self-hosting the included collaboration server).
- In-app feedback form that emails the maintainer.
